critical_controls.control_note: The route keeps the action reachable while typing or provides a truthful dismiss-and-resume path that does not lose the voter’s place.
Correction text remains discoverable while the keyboard is open rather than being hidden below the viewport.

delivery_role_note: The service reviews key public routes while the on-screen keyboard is open and keeps the current answer/help lane recoverable instead of hiding continuation or correction controls beneath the keyboard.
dismiss_and_resume_note: Users can dismiss the keyboard or move focus and resume the route without losing the current answer/help context.
error_or_help_visibility_note: Error/help text remains practically recoverable while the keyboard is open, not only after the keyboard closes.
focused_entry_vs_committed_review_note: The route keeps keyboard-open entry state distinct from reviewed result, accepted submission, or server-reviewed outcome state.

keyboard_open_route_classes.class_note: When a voter focuses the lookup field on mobile, the current answer/help lane remains recoverable and the lookup action is still reachable without guesswork.
Field-adjacent guidance and page-level correction text remain visible enough to recover while the keyboard is open.

layout_adaptation_note: Any browser-specific layout adaptation such as viewport resize handling is reviewed explicitly rather than assumed to work uniformly everywhere.
support_variance_note: Browser keyboard-resize and keyboard-geometry features vary, so the route does not depend on one experimental API as its only safe path.
virtual_keyboard_surface_label: Example keyboard-open posture for official voter-information routes
visual_viewport_behavior_note: Reviewed mobile flows distinguish keyboard-open visual-viewport changes from the resting page state so hidden controls are not mistaken for absent controls.
